knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A stain under the sheets is still on the bed and can be seen or felt when the bed is turned down.
A stained cover is not used. It is reported and replaced under the spare linen procedure.
Clean hands and keeping linen off the floor protect it from contamination.

practicalCriteria: Builds a simulated bed in the set layer order, smoothing each layer before the next is added.
Checks the mattress, protector and each cover for stains, tears and lint, and reports a seeded fault.
Carries clean linen to the bed without contact with the floor, bins or bathroom areas, as observed.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Linen check recorded on the simulated room checklist
Assessor observation record and photo of the made bed
stopWorkCriteria: Stained or torn linen placed on a bed for a guest
Clean linen placed on the floor
